name: fibroblast growth factor receptor 4

function.text: FGFR4 encodes fibroblast growth factor receptor 4. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and fibroblast growth factor receptor activity. It participates in positive regulation of catalytic activity and cell migration.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Glioblastoma Multiforme. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
